_note: Single source of truth for all models on this USB. Update if newer Dolphin builds are released.

primary_model.name: Dolphin 2.9 Mistral 7B
primary_model.reason: Primary uncensored model. Fine-tuned to follow uncensored system prompts. Best all-round capability at 7B.

backup_model.name: Dolphin 2.8 Llama 3 8B
backup_model.reason: More capable than Mistral 7B, slightly slower. Use when Mistral struggles with complex tasks.

coding_model.name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B Instruct
coding_model.reason: Best open-source coding model at 7B. Outperforms Llama and Mistral on code tasks.

teaching_model.name: Llama 3 8B Instruct
teaching_model.reason: Reliable filtered model for classroom or student-facing use where uncensored is inappropriate.
